Lifecycle status describes execution, not scientific truth. Persisted metadata is a record, not proof 
evidence.
Quarantined model artifacts are not assumptions. Sourced means identifiable provenance, never theorem 
verification.
A surviving candidate or bypass passed only a bounded attack; no proof verification is implied.
Receipt/review uncertainty is unreconciled history; model output is not necessarily an accepted graph 
artifact.
Token tallies are known subtotals; unknown_calls distinguishes missing telemetry from zero. Costs are recorded
estimates.
